cards.question: What does an atomic Ordering parameter control?
cards.answer: It controls what guarantees we get about the relative ordering of operations. Every atomic operation takes a std::sync::atomic::Ordering.

cards.question: Why can two threads see different assignment orders?
cards.answer: The CPU may perform operations out of order, grouping assignments even if the source is written differently. T1 might see V1 V2 V3 while T2 sees V2 V3 V1.

cards.question: Why might a Relaxed stop flag not stop immediately?
cards.answer: If some_work() is blocking or slow, setting STOP only ends the loop after that last call to some_work finishes.
